intermediate.title: Sprint | 1st passage of the finish line (173.9 km)

story: Stage 3 of PostNord Tour of Denmark 2026 featured an early breakaway of 4 riders, with Bech Aksel Skot-Hansen claiming the KOM jersey. Rain caused crashes, thinning the peloton and highlighting race favorites. On the final climb in Velje, Van Aert attacked and won the stage, extending his overall lead.
